scope: Three of seven adapted LangArena tasks, V8 only; complete translated programs with distinct ABIs and U32 versus U8 element payloads. Not a full-language or Gdev score.

coverage.note: Shared translated algorithms, not identical source or a full-language/50-task claim.

method.cold_build: Fresh driver and compiler per sample; cache disabled. OS and installed-library caches retained. Source staging outside timer. Complete wall and native build phases retained.
method.runtime: Same Node/V8 and flags for both. test/run use official inputs/iterations/warmups. bounded retains production problem sizes with reduced counts recorded per case. Same state retained after warmup. Preparation, startup, engine compilation and output outside clock; no per-element host calls. Two Blot clock packet crossings versus two Goose scalar imports are part of their ABI costs. Common process wall includes parsing the Blot TypeScript guest host for both backends; it is not Goose's standalone runner startup score.
method.representation: Goose hash data is U8; Blot stores identical 0..255 values in U32, 4x element payload bytes; owner and arena overhead are separate. Fixed 1m-element capacity retained. Fannkuch indices/permutations are nonnegative; U32 checksum wrap preserves final U32 accumulation. Wider parameter/clock plumbing stays outside kernels. Custom Hash::SHA256 is the original eight-lane custom hash, not cryptographic SHA-256.
method.ordering: Build phase sequential, then runtime phase; seeded paired shuffling, no deliberate concurrent measurement work.

notes: Use unprofiled compilation observations and five-pair bounded runtime observations. Runtime artifacts were originally built with compiler profiling enabled; all twelve artifact variants match the later unprofiled builds byte-for-byte.

Official production pilot retained unmodified input sizes, repetitions and warmups. Blot hit the 30s whole-process cap on all three cells; those are not measured kernel times or numeric slowdown ratios.
Bounded workloads retain production problem sizes and fixed capacities with reduced repetition/warmup counts explicitly recorded in case configs.
Blot hash buffers have 4x element payload bytes. Owners, headers and reserved arenas have separate overhead; this is not a 4x total-memory claim.
Shared host: an unrelated Rust release compilation was observed during measurements. Paired samples and dispersion are retained; do not interpret close compile-time differences as stable rankings.
The original bounded pilot used the wrong warmup config key for Fannkuch and custom hash; checksum validation rejected both backends. It is excluded from performance results.
The Goose checkout was dirty and changed externally during this work. Its installed binary, standard library and original runtime were frozen; checkout HEAD is not asserted as binary provenance.

catalog.name: Hash::SHA256
catalog.notes: Upstream task name; this is LangArena's custom hash, not standard cryptographic SHA-256.

qualification.independent_checksums: Official test/run expectations checked independently for all three cases before timing; bounded expectations generated by reference.py.
qualification.timeout_control: Sleeping child killed at 50ms cap with SIGKILL (-9); status timeout.
qualification.runtime_host_and_versions: Every original runtime/qualification Node and V8 version rechecked; current runtime.ts SHA-256 matches measured version.
